title: Vicenin-2 alleviates oxidative stress in HT22 cells and Caenorhabditis elegans as a potential KEAP1-NRF2 interaction inhibitor.
authors: Liang, Yu-Wen; Liang, Xiao-Lu; Mo, Fei-Fan; Tian, Jing; Qin, Ke-Jie; Zhao, Yao; Yuan, Xu-Jiang; Pan, Tian-Ming; Li, Kun-Ping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮化合物vicenin-2抑制KEAP1-NRF2蛋白-蛋白相互作用以缓解氧化应激，虽涉及分子对接与动力学模拟，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可迁移，故评分较低。
abstract: Flavone C-glycosides are a class of compounds characterized by glycosyl moieties directly bonded to the flavone skeleton via CC linkages, predominantly on the C-6 and C-8 positions of the A-ring. Vicenin-2, a 6,8-di-C-glycoside derived from apigenin, is widely present in some dietary sources such as juice, herbal teas and stewed soups. While its antioxidant potential is recognized, the molecular mechanisms underlying its protective effects against oxidative stress remain poorly explored. Given the vicious cycle between oxidative stress and neurotoxicity, this study investigated the protective efficacy and molecular mechanisms of vicenin-2 against t-Butyl Hydroperoxide (tBHP)-challenged Caenorhabditis elegans and H(2)O(2)-induced HT22 neuronal cells. Molecular docking and dynamics simulation revealed that vicenin-2 disrupts the binding of KEAP1 and NRF2. Both in vitro and in vivo assay demonstrated treatment of vicenin-2 activated the antioxidant system, and qPCR and Western blot results confirmed the KEAP1-NRF2-HO-1 pathway as central to its activities. Computational-experimental synergy unveils vicenin-2 as a KEAP1-NRF2 protein-protein interaction inhibitor. Our findings highlight the potential of vicenin-2 for oxidative stress conditions, and position vicenin-2 as a promising neuroprotective therapeutic candidate although more mammal experimental evidence is warranted.
abstract_zh: 黄酮C-糖苷是一类通过C-C键将糖基直接连接至黄酮骨架的化合物，主要位于A环的C-6和C-8位。Vicenin-2，一种源自芹菜素的6,8-二-C-糖苷，广泛存在于果汁、草药茶和炖汤等膳食来源中。尽管其抗氧化潜力已被认可，但其针对氧化应激的保护作用的分子机制仍鲜有探索。鉴于氧化应激与神经毒性之间的恶性循环，本研究探讨了vicenin-2对叔丁基过氧化氢（tBHP）挑战的秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）和H(2)O(2)诱导的HT22神经元细胞的保护功效及分子机制。分子对接和动力学模拟揭示，vicenin-2破坏了KEAP1与NRF2的结合。体外和体内实验均表明，vicenin-2处理激活了抗氧化系统，qPCR和Western blot结果确认KEAP1-NRF2-HO-1通路是其活性的核心。计算与实验的协同作用揭示了vicenin-2作为KEAP1-NRF2蛋白-蛋白相互作用抑制剂。我们的发现强调了vicenin-2在氧化应激条件下的潜力，并将其定位为有前景的神经保护治疗候选物，尽管仍需更多哺乳动物实验证据支持。
